Priya: Quick async standup — yesterday: ran the SLO regression for the embed-service (baseline vs q4-params), found a ~0.6% p99 increase in eu-west and traced noisy pages to duplicate alert grouping keys. Investigated logs, saw identical groups coming from two Alertmanager clusters after a failover. Blockers: need a small alert rule/route tweak + a runbook section for dedupe. Today: will open the dedupe PR, kick off a short canary, and follow up on the oncall tickets. Also finished KV eviction rollout. CC @Sam, @Jorge for alert + runbook.

Sam: on it. can you paste the alert rule id/snippet and the grouping labels? i'll check grouping & routing.

Priya: sure — snippet below (current rule):
```
- alert: EmbedServiceHighError
  expr: sum(rate(embed_errors_total[2m])) by (instance, cluster)
  for: 1m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "embed svc errors high"
```
Problem: grouping by (instance, cluster) plus a downstream dedupe mismatch duplicates pages when clusters failover. plan: change grouping to (cluster) and add a small suppress window.

Jorge: i'll take the runbook changes and add a 'dedupe' play section with steps to check group keys, silence, and restore. also add rollback steps for the last config deploy (commit abc1234). i'll open PR shortly.

Taylor: fyi oncall saw two 502 pages earlier from eu-west — linked/incidents: <https://incidents.redwood/internal/INC-4321>. looks like client retries + short flare. do we want a temporary debounce while we patch?

oncall-bot: Rotation notice — Sam -> Jorge at 18:00 UTC today. Incident INC-4321 acknowledged by Taylor.

Sam: temporary debounce ok. i'll add `suppress_for: 2m` to the rule in a staging patch and push to canary. Priya, can you kick the canary once the PR is up? :thumbsup:

Priya: yes — canary window 30m, I'll watch latency and p99s. if we see regressions, we'll revert the last config (abc1234) and rollback. i'll also attach the perf charts here after the run. quick note: the SLO regression seems correlated with a quantization patch rolled last week but i want to confirm — observing now.

Jorge: runbook PR: https://git.redwood/runs/1234 — added steps: check alertmanager clusters, verify grouping key, silence duplicates, escalate to infra if cross-cluster routing is misbehaving. added an escalation path that includes oncall manager.

Taylor: i manually cleared the duplicate pages earlier and left a short note in the incident. looks like two AM clusters processed the same events during a leader election — might need routing guards.

Sam: i'll open the alertmanager patch and tag @eng-infra for review. ETA ~2h. i'll also add a note to the PR about the suppress_for change so it's obvious in the diff.

Priya: thanks. small ask — can someone pick up the kv-warmup follow-up ticket? it will reduce cold-start blips for SLOs. ticket: #SRE-214

Jorge: i'll pick kv-warmup follow-up after the runbook PR lands.

Sam: summary of owners: Priya -> dedupe alert PR + canary, Sam -> alertmanager patch & staging canary, Jorge -> runbook PR + kv follow-up, Taylor -> incident triage + notes. any objections? :white_check_mark:

Priya: all good — thanks team. i'll post canary start time and perf links in this thread once live.
